q: किसे 'अर्थशास्त्र का जनक (Father of Economics)' कहा जाता है, जिन्होंने 1776 में 'वेल्थ ऑफ नेशंस' (राष्ट्रों की संपत्ति) लिखी?
e:
Scottish philosopher Adam Smith published 'The Wealth of Nations' in 1776, introducing the 'Invisible Hand' (price mechanism) and Division of Labour.
एडम स्मिथ (1776) अर्थशास्त्र के जनक हैं।
qe: Who is universally recognized as the 'Father of Economics' and authored 'An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations' (1776)?

q: अर्थशास्त्र में किसी विशेष विकल्प को चुनने की 'अवसर लागत' (Opportunity Cost) को किस रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है?
o: The total accounting expenditure in rupees
The value of the NEXT BEST alternative foregone
The sum of all possible alternatives combined
e:
Opportunity cost is the benefit of the next best alternative sacrificed when making an economic choice under scarcity.
अवसर लागत त्यागे गए अगले सर्वोत्तम विकल्प का मूल्य होती है।
qe: In economics, 'Opportunity Cost' (अवसर लागत) of choosing a particular alternative is defined as:
oe: The total accounting expenditure in rupees
The value of the NEXT BEST alternative foregone
The sum of all possible alternatives combined

q: अपनी 1890 की प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक 'प्रिंसिपल्स ऑफ इकोनॉमिक्स' में धन के स्थान पर मानव कल्याण को केंद्र में रखते हुए अर्थशास्त्र की 'कल्याणकारी परिभाषा' किसने दी?
e:
Alfred Marshall (1890) defined Economics as "a study of mankind in the ordinary business of life," emphasizing material requisites of well-being.
अल्फ्रेड मार्शल ने 1890 में अर्थशास्त्र की कल्याणकारी परिभाषा दी।
qe: Who gave the 'Welfare Definition' of Economics in his 1890 masterpiece 'Principles of Economics', shifting focus from wealth to human welfare?

q: स्वतंत्रता के बाद से भारत की आर्थिक प्रणाली को 'मिश्रित अर्थव्यवस्था (Mixed Economy)' क्यों कहा जाता है?
o: Only agriculture and handicrafts exist side by side.
Both the Public Sector (State-owned) and the Private Sector coexist and operate together with regulatory planning.
All land is owned exclusively by the Central Government.
e:
A Mixed Economy combines market freedom (private enterprise) with state ownership/welfare intervention (public sector), formally adopted in India's Industrial Policy Resolutions of 1948 and 1956.
मिश्रित अर्थव्यवस्था में सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र और निजी क्षेत्र दोनों का सह-अस्तित्व होता है।
qe: India's economic system since Independence is best characterized as a 'Mixed Economy' because:
oe: Only agriculture and handicrafts exist side by side.
Both the Public Sector (State-owned) and the Private Sector coexist and operate together with regulatory planning.
All land is owned exclusively by the Central Government.

q: 'सम-सीमांत उपयोगिता नियम' (MU_x / P_x = MU_y / P_y), जो बताता है कि विवेकशील उपभोक्ता सीमित आय को विभिन्न वस्तुओं पर कैसे व्यय करता है, और किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e:
Hermann Heinrich Gossen formulated Gossen's First Law (Diminishing Marginal Utility) and Gossen's Second Law (Equi-Marginal Utility / Law of Substitution).
सम-सीमांत उपयोगिता नियम को 'गॉसेन का द्वितीय नियम' भी कहा जाता है।
qe: The 'Law of Equi-Marginal Utility' (MU_x / P_x = MU_y / P_y), explaining how a rational consumer allocates limited income across multiple goods, is also known as:

q: अल्फ्रेड मार्शल के गणनावाचक उपयोगिता विश्लेषण में 'उपभोक्ता की बचत (Consumer's Surplus)' कैसे मापी जाती है?
o: Price actually paid minus Maximum price willing to pay
Maximum price a consumer is willing to pay minus the price actually paid (Total Utility − Total Expenditure)
e:
Consumer's Surplus (first hinted by Jules Dupuit 1844, popularized by Marshall, refined by Hicks using Indifference Curves) = What a consumer is willing to pay − What he actually pays.
उपभोक्ता की बचत = देने की तत्परता वाला मूल्य − वास्तव में चुकाया गया मूल्य।
qe: In Alfred Marshall's Cardinal Utility Analysis, 'Consumer's Surplus' (उपभोक्ता की बचत) is measured as:
oe: Price actually paid minus Maximum price willing to pay
Maximum price a consumer is willing to pay minus the price actually paid (Total Utility − Total Expenditure)

q: एक ही उपभोक्ता के दो उदासीनता वक्र (Indifference Curves) एक-दूसरे को कभी क्यों नहीं काट सकते?
o: Because they are always parallel straight lines
Because Marginal Utility is always increasing
Because intersection would violate the assumption of Transitivity and Monotonicity (consistency of preferences)
e:
If IC₁ and IC₂ intersected at point A, then A would give equal satisfaction to two bundles B (on IC₁) and C (on IC₂) where C has strictly more of both goods than B — contradicting transitivity and non-satiation.
दो उदासीनता वक्रों का प्रतिच्छेदन अधिमान की संक्रामकता (transitivity) और एकदिष्टता के नियम का उल्लंघन करता है।
qe: Why can two Indifference Curves of the same consumer NEVER intersect each other?
oe: Because they are always parallel straight lines
Because Marginal Utility is always increasing
Because intersection would violate the assumption of Transitivity and Monotonicity (consistency of preferences)

q: नीचे की ओर झुके सरल रेखीय माँग वक्र पर माँग की कीमत लोच मापने की ज्यामितीय (बिंदु) विधि के अनुसार माँग वक्र के ठीक मध्यबिंदु पर लोच का मान क्या होता है?
e:
Point Elasticity = Lower Segment / Upper Segment. At the exact midpoint, Lower Segment = Upper Segment ⇒ e_d = 1 (Unitary Elastic). Above midpoint e_d > 1; below midpoint e_d < 1; at Y-intercept ∞; at X-intercept 0.
मध्यबिंदु पर निचला भाग = ऊपरी भाग होने से लोच इकाई (1) होती है।
qe: According to the Geometric (Point) Method of measuring Price Elasticity of Demand on a straight-line downward-sloping demand curve, what is the elasticity at the EXACT MIDPOINT of the demand curve?

q: आय उपभोग वक्र (ICC) से व्युत्पन्न 'एंजेल वक्र (Engel Curve)' क्या दर्शाता है?
o: Relationship between price of a good and its quantity supplied
Relationship between interest rate and investment
Relationship between a consumer's money income and the quantity purchased of a specific commodity (holding prices constant)
e:
Ernst Engel (1857) observed that as household income rises, the proportion of income spent on food declines (Engel's Law). The Engel Curve plots quantity demanded of a good against consumer income (upward sloping for normal goods, backward-bending for inferior goods).
एंजेल वक्र उपभोक्ता की आय और किसी वस्तु की खरीदी गई मात्रा के बीच संबंध दर्शाता है।
qe: What does the 'Engel Curve' (derived from the Income Consumption Curve — ICC) depict?
oe: Relationship between price of a good and its quantity supplied
Relationship between interest rate and investment
Relationship between a consumer's money income and the quantity purchased of a specific commodity (holding prices constant)

q: 'वेब्लेन प्रभाव' (प्रतिष्ठासूचक/विलासिता वस्तुओं जैसे हीरे का दिखावटी उपभोग) माँग के नियम का अपवाद क्यों उत्पन्न करता है?
o: Price elasticity of prestige goods is always infinite.
Prestige goods are strictly inferior goods.
Consumers buy MORE of such prestige goods when their price rises (higher price signals higher social status).
Prestige goods have zero production cost.
e:
Thorstein Veblen ('The Theory of the Leisure Class', 1899) explained that for status-symbol goods, higher prices enhance prestige appeal, leading to an upward-sloping demand curve.
ऊँची कीमत सामाजिक प्रतिष्ठा का प्रतीक बनने से कीमत बढ़ने पर इनकी माँग भी बढ़ती है।
qe: The 'Veblen Effect' (conspicuous consumption of prestige/snob goods like luxury diamonds) causes an exception to the Law of Demand because:
oe: Price elasticity of prestige goods is always infinite.
Prestige goods are strictly inferior goods.
Consumers buy MORE of such prestige goods when their price rises (higher price signals higher social status).
Prestige goods have zero production cost.

q: उत्पादन सिद्धांत में 'सम-उत्पाद वक्र (Isoquant)' उपभोक्ता के उदासीनता वक्र का उत्पादक समतुल्य है। यह क्या दर्शाता है?
o: Maximum profit at varying market prices
All combinations of two inputs that cost the same total money
All combinations of two inputs (Labour & Capital) that yield the SAME level of total output
Total fixed cost at different output levels
e:
An Isoquant (Equal Product Curve) shows all technically efficient combinations of two factors (L, K) yielding identical output. Its slope is MRTS_LK = MP_L / MP_K. (Equal cost combinations form an Isocost Line.)
सम-उत्पाद वक्र दो साधनों के उन सभी संयोगों को दर्शाता है जो समान उत्पादन मात्रा देते हैं।
qe: An 'Isoquant' (सम-उत्पाद वक्र) in production theory is the producer's counterpart of a consumer's Indifference Curve. What does it represent?
oe: Maximum profit at varying market prices
All combinations of two inputs that cost the same total money
All combinations of two inputs (Labour & Capital) that yield the SAME level of total output
Total fixed cost at different output levels

q: अल्पकाल में सीमांत लागत (MC) तथा औसत लागत (AC) वक्रों के बीच सटीक ग्राफीय संबंध क्या होता है?
o: MC curve always lies above AC curve.
MC and AC curves never intersect.
MC curve cuts the AC curve from ABOVE at the maximum point of AC.
MC curve cuts the AC curve from BELOW at the MINIMUM point of AC.
e:
When AC is falling, MC < AC; when AC is at its minimum, MC = AC; when AC is rising, MC > AC. Thus MC cuts both AC and AVC from below at their respective minimum points.
MC वक्र AC वक्र को नीचे से उसके न्यूनतम बिंदु पर काटता है।
qe: What is the exact graphical relationship between Marginal Cost (MC) and Average Cost (AC) curves in the short run?
oe: MC curve always lies above AC curve.
MC and AC curves never intersect.
MC curve cuts the AC curve from ABOVE at the maximum point of AC.
MC curve cuts the AC curve from BELOW at the MINIMUM point of AC.

q: किसी फर्म का 'सम-विच्छेद बिंदु (Break-Even Point)' क्या होता है?
o: Where Total Revenue equals Total Cost (TR = TC, i.e., AR = AC — zero economic profit, normal profit only)
Where Total Variable Cost equals Total Fixed Cost
e:
At the Break-Even Point, TR = TC (AR = AC), meaning the firm earns zero supernormal profit (just normal profit, no loss).
सम-विच्छेद बिंदु पर कुल आगम = कुल लागत (TR = TC) होता है (न लाभ, न हानि)।
qe: What is the 'Break-Even Point' (सम-विच्छेद बिंदु) of a firm?
oe: Where Total Revenue equals Total Cost (TR = TC, i.e., AR = AC — zero economic profit, normal profit only)
Where Total Variable Cost equals Total Fixed Cost

q: सम-उत्पाद वक्र विश्लेषण में 'कटक रेखाएँ (Ridge Lines)' उत्पादन के आर्थिक क्षेत्र को घेरती हैं। ऊपरी और निचली कटक रेखाओं पर क्रमशः पूँजी (MP_K) और श्रम (MP_L) का सीमांत उत्पाद क्या होता है?
o: Both are strictly negative inside the ridge lines
MP_K = 0 on the upper ridge line and MP_L = 0 on the lower ridge line
e:
Between the two ridge lines, both MP_L > 0 and MP_K > 0 (downward-sloping isoquant segments). On the upper ridge line MP_K = 0 (vertical tangents) and on the lower ridge line MP_L = 0 (horizontal tangents).
ऊपरी कटक रेखा पर MP_K = 0 तथा निचली कटक रेखा पर MP_L = 0 होता है।
qe: In isoquant analysis, the 'Ridge Lines' (कटक रेखाएँ) enclose the 'Economic Region of Production'. What is the value of Marginal Product of Labour (MP_L) and Marginal Product of Capital (MP_K) along the upper and lower ridge lines respectively?
oe: Both are strictly negative inside the ridge lines
MP_K = 0 on the upper ridge line and MP_L = 0 on the lower ridge line

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी 'आंतरिक बचत' न होकर 'पैमाने की बाह्य बचत (External Economy of Scale)' है?
o: Installation of a specialized large machine inside a single firm
Bulk raw material discount negotiated by one large firm
Development of skilled local labour pool, specialized ancillary industries, and better transport/infrastructure shared by ALL firms in an industrial cluster
Hiring a specialized marketing manager by one firm
e:
Internal economies accrue to a single firm from its own expansion; External economies (Alfred Marshall) accrue to ALL firms in an industry from industry-wide localization/growth (shared infrastructure, skilled labour pool, trade journals).
औद्योगिक क्षेत्र में सभी फर्मों को साझा रूप से मिलने वाली कुशल श्रम व परिवहन सुविधाएँ बाह्य बचतें हैं।
qe: Which of the following is an 'External Economy of Scale' (बाह्य बचत) rather than an Internal Economy of Scale?
oe: Installation of a specialized large machine inside a single firm
Bulk raw material discount negotiated by one large firm
Development of skilled local labour pool, specialized ancillary industries, and better transport/infrastructure shared by ALL firms in an industrial cluster
Hiring a specialized marketing manager by one firm

q: पूर्ण प्रतियोगिता के अंतर्गत दीर्घकाल में एक फर्म पूर्ण संतुलन (अतिसामान्य लाभ शून्य, इष्टतम पैमाना) किस बिंदु पर प्राप्त करती है?
o: P = AR = MR = LMC = minimum LAC
e:
Free entry/exit forces P = LAC, and profit maximization requires MR = LMC. Since P = MR, long-run equilibrium occurs at the exact minimum of LAC: P = AR = MR = LMC = LAC_min.
दीर्घकाल में पूर्ण प्रतियोगी फर्म का संतुलन P = AR = MR = LMC = न्यूनतम LAC पर होता है।
qe: In the long run under Perfect Competition, a firm achieves full equilibrium (optimal scale with zero supernormal profit) at the point where:
oe: P = AR = MR = LMC = minimum LAC

q: एब्बा लर्नर के एकाधिकार शक्ति सूचकांक (Lerner's Index) के अनुसार एकाधिकार शक्ति की मात्रा को गणितीय रूप से कैसे मापा जाता है?
e:
Lerner Index L = (P − MC)/P. Since MR = MC = P(1 − 1/e), substituting MC gives L = 1/e (inverse of price elasticity of demand). Under perfect competition, P = MC ⇒ L = 0.
लर्नर सूचकांक = (P − MC)/P = 1/e है।
qe: According to Abba Lerner's Index of Monopoly Power, the degree of monopoly power is mathematically measured as:

q: 'द्विपक्षीय एकाधिकार (Bilateral Monopoly)' क्या होता है?
o: Two sellers competing against many buyers
Two countries signing a free trade agreement
A single firm selling two different products
A single seller (Monopolist) facing a single buyer (Monopsonist) in the same market
e:
Bilateral Monopoly occurs when a single seller (e.g., strong trade union) confronts a single buyer (e.g., sole employer/monopsonist); price and quantity become indeterminate and depend on relative bargaining power.
जब बाजार में एक ही विक्रेता (एकाधिकारी) का सामना एक ही क्रेता (क्रेता-एकाधिकारी) से हो, तो उसे द्विपक्षीय एकाधिकार कहते हैं।
qe: What is 'Bilateral Monopoly' (द्विपक्षीय एकाधिकार)?
oe: Two sellers competing against many buyers
Two countries signing a free trade agreement
A single firm selling two different products
A single seller (Monopolist) facing a single buyer (Monopsonist) in the same market

q: प्रतिष्ठित द्व्याधिकार (Duopoly) सिद्धांत में 'बर्ट्रेंड मॉडल' (1883) 'कूर्नो मॉडल' (1838) से किस प्रकार भिन्न है?
o: Cournot deals with agriculture only, while Bertrand deals with banking only.
Both models assume collusion via a cartel.
Bertrand assumes zero competition, while Cournot assumes monopoly.
Cournot assumes each duopolist takes the rival's OUTPUT as constant, whereas Bertrand assumes each takes the rival's PRICE as constant (leading to competitive P = MC).
e:
Cournot (1838, mineral water springs) uses Output as the strategic variable (each firm produces 1/3 of competitive output, total 2/3); Bertrand (1883) uses Price as the strategic variable, triggering price wars down to P = MC.
कूर्नो मॉडल में प्रतिद्वंद्वी का 'उत्पादन' स्थिर माना जाता है, जबकि बर्ट्रेंड मॉडल में 'कीमत' स्थिर मानी जाती है।
qe: In Classical Duopoly theory, how does the 'Bertrand Model' (1883) differ from the 'Cournot Model' (1838)?
oe: Cournot deals with agriculture only, while Bertrand deals with banking only.
Both models assume collusion via a cartel.
Bertrand assumes zero competition, while Cournot assumes monopoly.
Cournot assumes each duopolist takes the rival's OUTPUT as constant, whereas Bertrand assumes each takes the rival's PRICE as constant (leading to competitive P = MC).

q: एकाधिकारात्मक प्रतियोगिता की मुख्य विशेषता के रूप में 'विक्रय लागत' (विज्ञापन व विक्रय संवर्धन व्यय) की अवधारणा किसने प्रस्तुत की?
e:
Edward Chamberlin ('The Theory of Monopolistic Competition', 1933) distinguished Production Costs from Selling Costs (advertising to differentiate products and shift demand).
चैम्बरलिन (1933) ने एकाधिकारात्मक प्रतियोगिता में विक्रय लागत की अवधारणा दी।
qe: Who introduced the concept of 'Selling Costs' (advertisement & sales promotion expenses to shift the demand curve rightward) as a hallmark of Monopolistic Competition?

q: लगान के आधुनिक सिद्धांत (जोन रॉबिन्सन / बोल्डिंग) के अनुसार उत्पादन के किसी भी साधन द्वारा अर्जित आर्थिक लगान किसके बराबर होता है?
e:
Economic Rent = Actual Earnings − Transfer Earnings (where Transfer Earnings is the minimum payment needed to retain a factor in its current use). If supply is perfectly inelastic, Transfer Earnings = 0 and all earnings are Rent.
आधुनिक सिद्धांत के अनुसार लगान = वास्तविक आय − हस्तांतरण आय।
qe: According to the Modern Theory of Rent (Joan Robinson / Boulding), Economic Rent earned by ANY factor of production is equal to:

q: अत्यंत उच्च मजदूरी दरों पर श्रम का व्यक्तिगत पूर्ति वक्र 'पीछे की ओर मुड़ने वाला (Backward-Bending)' क्यों हो जाता है?
o: Because workers prefer to work 24 hours a day at higher wages
Because employers refuse to hire workers
Because beyond a high wage level, the Income Effect (preference for more leisure as income rises) outweighs the Substitution Effect (higher opportunity cost of leisure)
e:
At low wages, higher wages induce more work (Substitution Effect > Income Effect). At very high wages, workers feel rich enough to buy more leisure (Income Effect > Substitution Effect), reducing hours worked.
उच्च मजदूरी पर आय प्रभाव (अधिक अवकाश की चाह) प्रतिस्थापन प्रभाव से प्रबल हो जाता है, जिससे श्रम पूर्ति घटने लगती है।
qe: Why does the individual supply curve of labour become 'Backward-Bending' at very high wage rates?
oe: Because workers prefer to work 24 hours a day at higher wages
Because employers refuse to hire workers
Because beyond a high wage level, the Income Effect (preference for more leisure as income rises) outweighs the Substitution Effect (higher opportunity cost of leisure)

q: वास्तविक कारकों (बचत, निवेश) तथा मौद्रिक कारकों (संचय, बैंक साख) दोनों को सम्मिलित करते हुए ब्याज का 'ऋणयोग्य कोष सिद्धांत' (नव-प्रतिष्ठित सिद्धांत) किन अर्थशास्त्रियों ने प्रतिपादित किया?
o: Knut Wicksell, Bertil Ohlin, and Dennis Robertson
e:
Swedish economist Knut Wicksell originated the Loanable Funds Theory, later refined by Bertil Ohlin, Gunnar Myrdal, and Dennis Robertson.
विकसेल, ओह्लिन तथा रॉबर्टसन ने ब्याज का ऋणयोग्य कोष सिद्धांत दिया।
qe: Which economists formulated the 'Loanable Funds Theory of Interest' (Neo-Classical Theory), incorporating both real factors (saving, investment) and monetary factors (hoarding, bank credit)?
oe: Knut Wicksell, Bertil Ohlin, and Dennis Robertson

q: वितरण के सीमांत उत्पादकता सिद्धांत (जे.बी. क्लार्क) में, वस्तु और साधन दोनों बाजारों में पूर्ण प्रतियोगिता के अंतर्गत एक फर्म श्रम की नियुक्ति उस बिंदु तक करती है जहाँ मजदूरी दर (W) बराबर हो:
o: Value of Marginal Product (VMP = MRP = MP × P)
e:
Under perfect competition, P = MR, so VMP (= MP × P) equals MRP (= MP × MR). Profit maximization requires Factor Price (W) = MRP = VMP.
पूर्ण प्रतियोगिता में फर्म वहाँ तक श्रम नियुक्त करती है जहाँ मजदूरी W = VMP = MRP हो।
qe: In the Marginal Productivity Theory of Distribution (J.B. Clark), under perfect competition in both product and factor markets, a firm hires labour up to the point where the Wage Rate (W) equals:
oe: Value of Marginal Product (VMP = MRP = MP × P)

q: अर्थशास्त्र में 'सामान्य लाभ' को कुल लागत (अस्पष्ट लागत) का भाग माना जाता है, जबकि 'आर्थिक (अतिसामान्य) लाभ' को किस रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है?
o: Total Revenue minus Explicit Costs only
Total Revenue minus Total Economic Costs (Explicit Costs + Implicit Costs including Normal Profit)
e:
Accounting Profit = TR − Explicit Costs. Economic (Pure/Supernormal) Profit = TR − (Explicit Costs + Implicit Costs). Thus when Economic Profit = 0, the firm still earns Normal Profit.
आर्थिक लाभ = कुल आगम − (स्पष्ट लागत + अस्पष्ट लागत)।
qe: In Economics, 'Normal Profit' is included as part of Total Cost (Implicit Cost), whereas 'Economic (Supernormal) Profit' is defined as:
oe: Total Revenue minus Explicit Costs only
Total Revenue minus Total Economic Costs (Explicit Costs + Implicit Costs including Normal Profit)

q: 'जीडीपी अवस्फीतिक (GDP Deflator)' (जो देश में उत्पादित सभी अंतिम वस्तुओं व सेवाओं की मुद्रास्फीति मापता है) की गणना कैसे की जाती है?
e:
GDP Deflator = (Nominal GDP at current prices / Real GDP at constant base-year prices) × 100.
GDP Deflator = (चालू कीमतों पर GDP / स्थिर कीमतों पर GDP) × 100।
qe: How is the 'GDP Deflator' (an economy-wide measure of inflation covering all domestically produced final goods and services) calculated?

q: किस प्रतिष्ठित सिद्धांत की 1936 में जे.एम. कीन्स ने तीखी आलोचना की थी, जो कहता है कि "पूर्ति अपनी माँग स्वयं उत्पन्न करती है"?
e:
French economist Jean-Baptiste Say propounded Say's Law ("Supply creates its own demand"). Keynes refuted it in 'The General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money' (1936) using the Principle of Effective Demand.
जे.बी. से का बाजार नियम कहता है कि "पूर्ति अपनी माँग स्वयं उत्पन्न करती है।"
qe: Which classical proposition, famously criticized by J.M. Keynes in 1936, states that "Supply creates its own demand", ruling out general overproduction or involuntary unemployment?

q: राष्ट्रीय आय मापन की मूल्य-वृद्धि विधि (उत्पाद विधि) में 'दोहरी गणना (Double Counting)' की समस्या से कैसे बचा जाता है?
o: By counting both intermediate goods and final goods together
By counting either the value of FINAL goods & services only OR summing the Gross Value Added (Output − Intermediate Consumption) at each stage
e:
Double counting is avoided by either taking only Final Output values or summing Value Added (= Value of Output − Intermediate Consumption) across all production enterprises.
केवल अंतिम वस्तुओं का मूल्य लेकर अथवा प्रत्येक चरण की मूल्य-वृद्धि (उत्पाद मूल्य − मध्यवर्ती उपभोग) जोड़कर दोहरी गणना से बचा जाता है।
qe: In the Value Added Method (Product Method) of measuring National Income, how is the problem of 'Double Counting' avoided?
oe: By counting both intermediate goods and final goods together
By counting either the value of FINAL goods & services only OR summing the Gross Value Added (Output − Intermediate Consumption) at each stage

q: ट्रिग्वे हावेलमो के 'संतुलित बजट गुणक प्रमेय' के अंतर्गत यदि सरकार अपने व्यय (ΔG) और एकमुश्त करों (ΔT) में ठीक बराबर वृद्धि करे (ΔG = ΔT), तो संतुलित बजट गुणक का मान क्या होता है?
e:
Government Expenditure Multiplier = 1/(1 − c); Tax Multiplier = −c/(1 − c).
Balanced Budget Multiplier = 1/(1 − c) − c/(1 − c) = (1 − c)/(1 − c) = 1. Thus ΔY = ΔG = ΔT!
संतुलित बजट गुणक सदैव 1 (इकाई) होता है।
qe: Under Trygve Haavelmo's 'Balanced Budget Multiplier Theorem', if the government increases its expenditure (ΔG) and lump-sum taxes (ΔT) by the EXACT SAME amount (ΔG = ΔT), what is the value of the Balanced Budget Multiplier?

q: जहाँ गुणक (कॉन/कीन्स) निवेश में परिवर्तन का आय पर प्रभाव मापता है, वहीं 'त्वरक सिद्धांत (Accelerator Principle — जे.एम. क्लार्क, 1917)' क्या मापता है?
o: The effect of a change in Consumption/Output on Induced Investment (ΔI = v · ΔY)
The effect of tax cuts on exports
The effect of population growth on land rent
The effect of CRR on inflation
e:
J.M. Clark's Accelerator shows how changes in demand/income induce magnified changes in net capital investment (I_t = v(Y_t − Y_{t−1})). Samuelson combined Multiplier + Accelerator to explain Business Cycles.
त्वरक सिद्धांत उपभोग/आय में परिवर्तन का प्रेरित निवेश पर प्रभाव (ΔI = v·ΔY) मापता है।
qe: While the Multiplier (Kahn/Keynes) measures the effect of a change in Investment on Income, what does the 'Accelerator Principle' (J.M. Clark, 1917) measure?
oe: The effect of a change in Consumption/Output on Induced Investment (ΔI = v · ΔY)
The effect of tax cuts on exports
The effect of population growth on land rent
The effect of CRR on inflation

q: मुद्रा के परिमाण सिद्धांत के कैम्ब्रिज नकद-शेष समीकरण (M = kPY — मार्शल, पीगू, रॉबर्टसन, कीन्स) में 'k' क्या दर्शाता है?
o: The velocity of circulation of bank cheques
The proportion of real national income that people desire to hold in the form of liquid cash balances
The statutory liquidity ratio of banks
The rate of consumer price inflation
e:
In M = kPY (or Pigou's P = kR/M), 'k' is the fraction of income people choose to hold as cash (note that k = 1/V in Fisher's equation). It highlights money's 'Store of Value' function.
'k' वास्तविक आय का वह अंश है जिसे लोग नकद शेष के रूप में अपने पास रखना चाहते हैं।
qe: In the Cambridge Cash-Balance Equation of the Quantity Theory of Money (M = kPY, associated with Marshall, Pigou, Robertson, Keynes), what does 'k' denote?
oe: The velocity of circulation of bank cheques
The proportion of real national income that people desire to hold in the form of liquid cash balances
The statutory liquidity ratio of banks
The rate of consumer price inflation

q: अल्पकाल में 'फिलिप्स वक्र (Phillips Curve — ए.डब्ल्यू. फिलिप्स, 1958)' किसके बीच संबंध दर्शाता है?
o: Direct relationship between tax rate and tax revenue
Inverse relationship (trade-off) between the rate of Unemployment and the rate of Inflation (wage/price rise)
Relationship between imports and exchange rate
Relationship between saving and interest rate
e:
The short-run Phillips Curve slopes downward, showing an inverse trade-off between unemployment and inflation. (In the long run, Milton Friedman & Edmund Phelps showed it is vertical at the Natural Rate of Unemployment / NAIRU.)
अल्पकालीन फिलिप्स वक्र बेरोजगारी दर और मुद्रास्फीति के बीच विपरीत संबंध दर्शाता है।
qe: What does the 'Phillips Curve' (A.W. Phillips, 1958) depict in the short run?
oe: Direct relationship between tax rate and tax revenue
Inverse relationship (trade-off) between the rate of Unemployment and the rate of Inflation (wage/price rise)
Relationship between imports and exchange rate
Relationship between saving and interest rate

q: केंद्रीय बैंक द्वारा सृजित 'उच्च-शक्ति मुद्रा (High-Powered Money / आरक्षित मुद्रा M0)' में क्या शामिल होता है?
o: Only gold bullion held by private households
Time deposits of commercial banks only
Foreign equity shares held by NRIs
e:
High-Powered Money H (M0) = C + R (Currency in circulation + Bankers' deposits with RBI + Other deposits with RBI). It forms the monetary base upon which the banking system multiplies money supply.
उच्च-शक्ति मुद्रा (H) = जनता के पास करेंसी (C) + बैंकों के नकद आरक्षित कोष (R)।
qe: 'High-Powered Money' (Reserve Money / Monetary Base, M0) created by the Central Bank consists of:
oe: Only gold bullion held by private households
Time deposits of commercial banks only
Foreign equity shares held by NRIs

q: जब कच्चे तेल की बढ़ती कीमतों, ऊँची मजदूरी या आपूर्ति-श्रृंखला व्यवधानों के कारण (समग्र पूर्ति वक्र बाईं ओर खिसकने से) कीमतें तेजी से बढ़ती हैं, तो इस मुद्रास्फीति को क्या कहते हैं?
e:
Cost-Push Inflation arises from rising production/input costs (leftward shift of AS curve), whereas Demand-Pull Inflation arises from excessive aggregate demand ("too much money chasing too few goods").
उत्पादन लागतों में वृद्धि से उत्पन्न मुद्रास्फीति 'लागत-जनित मुद्रास्फीति' कहलाती है।
qe: When general prices rise sharply because of soaring crude oil prices, higher wages, or supply-chain disruptions (shifting the Aggregate Supply curve leftward), this type of inflation is called:

q: RBI के प्राथमिकता प्राप्त क्षेत्र ऋण (PSL) मानदंडों के अंतर्गत भारत के घरेलू अनुसूचित वाणिज्यिक बैंकों को अपने समायोजित शुद्ध बैंक ऋण (ANBC) का न्यूनतम कितना प्रतिशत प्राथमिकता प्राप्त क्षेत्रों (कृषि, MSME, शिक्षा, आवास) को देना अनिवार्य है?
e:
Domestic scheduled commercial banks must allocate at least 40% of ANBC to Priority Sectors (including 18% sub-target for Agriculture, 7.5% for Micro Enterprises, and 12% for Weaker Sections). (For RRBs and Small Finance Banks, PSL target is 75%.)
घरेलू वाणिज्यिक बैंकों के लिए PSL लक्ष्य 40% है।
qe: Under RBI's Priority Sector Lending (PSL) norms, domestic scheduled commercial banks in India are mandated to direct what minimum percentage of their Adjusted Net Bank Credit (ANBC) to priority sectors (agriculture, MSMEs, education, housing)?

q: कराधान के चार प्रसिद्ध सिद्धांत (Canons of Taxation) — समानता, निश्चितता, सुविधा और मितव्ययिता — किसने प्रतिपादित किए?
e:
Adam Smith laid down the four classic Canons of Taxation in 'The Wealth of Nations' (1776): Equality, Certainty, Convenience, and Economy. (Bastable later added Productivity, Elasticity, Simplicity, Diversity.)
एडम स्मिथ ने कराधान के चार मूल सिद्धांत प्रतिपादित किए।
qe: Who formulated the four classic 'Canons of Taxation' — Equality (Ability to Pay), Certainty, Convenience, and Economy?

q: भारतीय लोक वित्त में 'राजस्व घाटा (Revenue Deficit)' गणितीय रूप से किसके बराबर होता है?
o: Total Expenditure minus Total Receipts excluding borrowings
e:
Revenue Deficit = Revenue Expenditure − Revenue Receipts (signifies government dissaving — borrowing to meet routine consumption expenses). Fiscal Deficit = Total Expenditure − Total Non-Debt Receipts; Primary Deficit = Fiscal Deficit − Interest Payments.
राजस्व घाटा = राजस्व व्यय − राजस्व प्राप्तियाँ।
qe: In Indian public finance, 'Revenue Deficit' is mathematically equal to:
oe: Total Expenditure minus Total Receipts excluding borrowings

q: वह कर जिसकी औसत दर करदाता की आय बढ़ने के साथ बढ़ती जाती है (जैसे भारत का व्यक्तिगत आयकर स्लैब), क्या कहलाता है?
e:
Progressive Tax places a higher percentage tax burden on higher incomes (promoting vertical equity). Regressive Tax takes a larger percentage of income from the poor (e.g., flat indirect taxes on essentials).
आय बढ़ने के साथ बढ़ती दर वाला कर 'प्रगतिशील कर' कहलाता है।
qe: A tax whose average rate INCREASES as the taxpayer's income increases (such as India's Personal Income Tax slabs) is called:

q: राजकोषीय अनुशासन को संस्थागत बनाने और राजकोषीय घाटे को कम करने हेतु भारतीय संसद द्वारा राजकोषीय उत्तरदायित्व एवं बजट प्रबंधन (FRBM) अधिनियम किस वर्ष पारित किया गया था?
e:
The FRBM Act was enacted in August 2003 (effective July 2004). Later, the N.K. Singh Committee (2017) reviewed FRBM and recommended a Debt-to-GDP anchor (60% combined: 40% Centre + 20% States) and 3% Fiscal Deficit target.
FRBM अधिनियम 2003 में पारित किया गया था।
qe: The Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act was enacted by the Indian Parliament in which year to institutionalize fiscal discipline and reduce fiscal deficits?

q: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार के हेक्शर-ओह्लिन (आधुनिक) सिद्धांत के अनुसार किसी देश के तुलनात्मक लाभ का निर्धारण किससे होता है?
o: Relative factor endowments — a country exports goods that intensively use its relatively ABUNDANT factor (e.g., labour-abundant nations export labour-intensive goods)
Gold and silver reserves held by the monarch (Mercantilism)
e:
Eli Heckscher (1919) and Bertil Ohlin (1933) explained trade via relative factor abundance. Wassily Leontief (1953) empirically tested it on the US and found the 'Leontief Paradox' (capital-rich US exported labour-intensive goods).
हेक्शर-ओह्लिन सिद्धांत के अनुसार देश अपने अपेक्षाकृत प्रचुर साधन-गहन वस्तुओं का निर्यात करता है।
qe: According to the Heckscher-Ohlin (Modern) Theory of International Trade, what determines a country's comparative advantage?
oe: Relative factor endowments — a country exports goods that intensively use its relatively ABUNDANT factor (e.g., labour-abundant nations export labour-intensive goods)
Gold and silver reserves held by the monarch (Mercantilism)

q: 'मार्शल-लर्नर शर्त' के अंतर्गत किसी देश की मुद्रा का अवमूल्यन उसके व्यापार संतुलन में सुधार तभी करेगा जब निर्यात (e_x) और आयात (e_m) की माँग की कीमत लोचों का योग:
e:
Marshall-Lerner Condition: e_x + e_m > 1 is required for devaluation to improve BoT (in the very short run, elasticities are low, creating the 'J-Curve effect' before improvement).
अवमूल्यन से व्यापार संतुलन सुधार हेतु e_x + e_m > 1 होना आवश्यक है।
qe: Under the 'Marshall-Lerner Condition', currency devaluation will IMPROVE a country's Balance of Trade (from initial equilibrium) if and only if the sum of the price elasticities of demand for exports (e_x) and imports (e_m) is:

q: किसी देश की 'शुद्ध वस्तु-विनिमय व्यापार शर्तें (Net Barter Terms of Trade)' कैसे परिभाषित की जाती हैं?
o: (Index of Export Prices / Index of Import Prices) × 100
(Index of Import Prices / Index of Export Prices) × 100
e:
Net Barter Terms of Trade (introduced by Taussig) N = (P_x / P_m) × 100. An increase in N indicates favourable terms of trade (more imports per unit of export).
शुद्ध वस्तु-विनिमय व्यापार शर्तें = (निर्यात मूल्य सूचकांक / आयात मूल्य सूचकांक) × 100।
qe: How is the 'Net Barter (Commodity) Terms of Trade' (N) of a country defined?
oe: (Index of Export Prices / Index of Import Prices) × 100
(Index of Import Prices / Index of Export Prices) × 100

q: वैश्विक एवं राष्ट्रीय बहुआयामी गरीबी सूचकांक (MPI — UNDP/OPHI तथा नीति आयोग) की गणना किन तीन मुख्य आयामों के आधार पर की जाती है?
o: Health, Education, and Standard of Living
Landholding, Tax Paid, and Bank Balance
e:
MPI uses 3 equally weighted dimensions (1/3 each) — Health, Education, and Standard of Living — across 10 indicators (12 indicators in NITI Aayog's National MPI adding Maternal Health & Bank Accounts).
MPI के तीन आयाम स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा और जीवन स्तर हैं।
qe: Which three core dimensions are used to compute the Global & National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI — UNDP/OPHI and NITI Aayog)?
oe: Health, Education, and Standard of Living
Landholding, Tax Paid, and Bank Balance

q: श्रमिकों के पास मौजूद कौशल और आधुनिक उद्योगों द्वारा आवश्यक कौशल के बीच असंतुलन (या अर्थव्यवस्था में संरचनात्मक परिवर्तन) से उत्पन्न बेरोजगारी क्या कहलाती है?
e:
Structural Unemployment arises from long-term shifts in economic structure/technology and skill mismatch. Frictional unemployment is short-term transitional unemployment between jobs; Cyclical occurs during recessions.
कौशल असंतुलन व आर्थिक संरचना परिवर्तन से उत्पन्न बेरोजगारी 'संरचनात्मक बेरोजगारी' कहलाती है।
qe: Unemployment caused by a mismatch between the skills possessed by workers and the skills demanded by modernizing industries (or structural shifts in the economy) is known as:

q: भारत के औद्योगिक नीति इतिहास में किस प्रस्ताव को 'भारत का आर्थिक संविधान' कहा जाता है, जिसने उद्योगों को अनुसूची A (17 सार्वजनिक), अनुसूची B (12 मिश्रित) और अनुसूची C (निजी) में वर्गीकृत किया?
e:
The Industrial Policy Resolution (IPR) of 30 April 1956 laid the foundation of India's socialist pattern of society and 2nd Five-Year Plan (Mahalanobis model), earning the epithet 'Economic Constitution of India'.
औद्योगिक नीति प्रस्ताव, 1956 को 'भारत का आर्थिक संविधान' कहा जाता है।
qe: In India's Industrial Policy history, which resolution is known as the 'Economic Constitution of India' because it classified industries into Schedule A (17 public), Schedule B (12 mixed), and Schedule C (private)?

q: मैक्स वेबर के अनुसार समाज और राजनीति में वैध प्राधिकार (Legitimate Authority) के तीन शुद्ध प्रकार कौन-से हैं?
e:
Max Weber classified legitimate authority into Traditional (custom/monarchy), Charismatic (personal magnetism), and Legal-Rational (constitutional rules & bureaucracy).
मैक्स वेबर ने वैध सत्ता के तीन प्रकार बताए— पारंपरिक, करिश्माई तथा विधिक-तार्किक।
qe: According to Max Weber, which are the three pure (ideal) types of Legitimate Authority in society and politics?

q: 'द सिविक कल्चर' (1963) में गैब्रियल आलमंड और सिडनी वर्बा ने राजनीतिक संस्कृति को किन तीन शुद्ध प्रकारों में वर्गीकृत किया?
e:
Almond & Verba ('The Civic Culture', 1963) identified Parochial (low awareness), Subject (aware of outputs, passive), and Participant (actively involved in inputs & outputs) political cultures, calling their stable mix 'Civic Culture'.
आलमंड और वर्बा ने संकीर्ण (Parochial), पराधीन (Subject) और सहभागी (Participant) राजनीतिक संस्कृति का वर्गीकरण किया।
qe: In 'The Civic Culture' (1963), Gabriel Almond and Sidney Verba classified Political Culture into which three pure types?

q: राजनीति विज्ञान का कौन-सा उपागम मुख्यतः औपचारिक कानूनी संस्थाओं, संविधानों, ऐतिहासिक विकास और 'क्या होना चाहिए' के मानकीय प्रश्नों पर केंद्रित होता है?
e:
The Traditional Approach (Philosophical, Historical, Legal, Institutional) dominated up to WWII, emphasizing normative ethics and formal structures, before the Behavioural Revolution shifted focus to empirical political behaviour.
पारंपरिक उपागम मानकीय मूल्यों, इतिहास और औपचारिक संस्थाओं पर केंद्रित होता है।
qe: Which approach to Political Science focuses primarily on formal legal institutions, constitutions, historical evolution, and normative questions of 'what ought to be'?

q: 'द पावर एलीट' (1956) पुस्तक किसने लिखी, जिसमें तर्क दिया गया कि आधुनिक औद्योगिक समाजों में शक्ति राजनीतिक, कॉर्पोरेट और सैन्य अभिजात वर्ग के त्रिकोण में केंद्रित होती है?
e:
C. Wright Mills ('The Power Elite', 1956) analyzed elite concentration in the USA. Pareto gave 'Circulation of Elites'; Mosca gave 'The Ruling Class'; Robert Michels gave 'Iron Law of Oligarchy'.
सी. राइट मिल्स ने 1956 में 'द पावर एलीट' लिखी।
qe: Who authored 'The Power Elite' (1956), arguing that power in modern industrial societies is concentrated in an interlocking triad of political, corporate, and military elites?

q: किस ब्रिटिश विचारक ने राजाओं के दैवीय अधिकार का समर्थन करते हुए 'पैट्रियार्का' (1680) लिखी थी, जिसका जॉन लॉक ने अपने प्रथम निबंध में खंडन किया?
e:
Sir Robert Filmer ('Patriarcha') defended Divine Right and Patriarchal absolute monarchy; Locke dismantled his arguments in the First Treatise of Government (1689).
सर रॉबर्ट फिल्मर ने 'पैट्रियार्का' में दैवीय अधिकार सिद्धांत का समर्थन किया।
qe: Which British thinker authored 'Patriarcha' (1680) defending the Divine Right of Kings, which John Locke famously refuted in his First Treatise of Government?

q: जहाँ सर हेनरी मेन ने राज्य की उत्पत्ति का 'पितृसत्तात्मक सिद्धांत' (Patriarchal Theory) प्रस्तुत किया, वहीं निम्नलिखित में से किसने 'मातृसत्तात्मक सिद्धांत' (Matriarchal Theory) का समर्थन किया?
e:
McLennan ('Primitive Marriage'), Lewis Henry Morgan ('Ancient Society'), and Edward Jenks ('A History of Politics') championed the Matriarchal Theory (polyandry and matrilineal descent preceding patriarchy).
मैकलेनन, मॉर्गन और जेक्स मातृसत्तात्मक सिद्धांत के प्रमुख समर्थक हैं।
qe: While Sir Henry Maine advocated the 'Patriarchal Theory' of the origin of the State, who among the following advocated the 'Matriarchal Theory'?

q: 'लोकप्रिय संप्रभुता (Popular Sovereignty)' — कि अंतिम सर्वोच्च शक्ति समग्र जनता में निहित है — की अवधारणा मुख्यतः किस विचारक से जुड़ी है?
e:
Jean-Jacques Rousseau ('The Social Contract', 1762) located inalienable, indivisible sovereignty in the 'General Will' of the people — establishing Popular Sovereignty.
जीन-जैक रूसो को लोकप्रिय संप्रभुता का प्रमुख प्रतिपादक माना जाता है।
qe: The concept of 'Popular Sovereignty' (लोकप्रिय संप्रभुता — that ultimate supreme power resides in the people as a whole) is most famously associated with which thinker?

q: ब्रिटेन की ऐतिहासिक 'बेवरिज रिपोर्ट' (1942) — जिसने पाँच महादानवों (अभाव, रोग, अज्ञानता, मलिनता, बेरोजगारी) पर प्रहार किया — ने राज्य की किस आधुनिक अवधारणा की आधारशिला रखी?
e:
William Beveridge's 1942 Report ('Social Insurance and Allied Services') became the foundation of the post-WWII Welfare State (cradle-to-grave social security), echoed in Part IV (DPSP) of the Indian Constitution.
बेवरिज रिपोर्ट (1942) ने आधुनिक 'लोक कल्याणकारी राज्य (Welfare State)' की नींव रखी।
qe: The landmark 'Beveridge Report' (1942) in the United Kingdom — attacking the 'Five Giant Evils' (Want, Disease, Ignorance, Squalor, Idleness) — laid the modern institutional blueprint for which concept of the State?

q: राजनीति विज्ञान में 'राष्ट्र (Nation)' की अवधारणा 'राज्य (State)' से किस प्रकार भिन्न है?
o: There is no distinction; both terms are legally identical.
Every State must have only one language and religion.
A Nation always possesses a standing army and tax system, whereas a State does not.

A State is a legal-political entity with definite territory, government, and sovereignty, whereas a Nation is primarily a cultural-psychological community united by shared history, language, or consciousness.
e:
State is a political-juridical organization (4 objective elements), whereas Nation is a subjective/cultural bond of shared identity (Ernest Renan: "a daily plebiscite"). Multi-national states (e.g., India, Canada, UK) contain diverse cultural groups within one sovereign State.
राज्य एक विधिक-राजनीतिक इकाई है, जबकि राष्ट्र साझा इतिहास व चेतना से जुड़ा सांस्कृतिक-मनोवैज्ञानिक समुदाय है।
qe: How does a 'Nation' conceptually differ from a 'State' in Political Science?
oe: There is no distinction; both terms are legally identical.
Every State must have only one language and religion.
A Nation always possesses a standing army and tax system, whereas a State does not.

A State is a legal-political entity with definite territory, government, and sovereignty, whereas a Nation is primarily a cultural-psychological community united by shared history, language, or consciousness.

q: अपने प्रसिद्ध निबंध 'सिटिज़नशिप एंड सोशल क्लास' (1950) में ब्रिटिश समाजशास्त्री टी.एच. मार्शल ने नागरिकता अधिकारों के ऐतिहासिक विकास का कौन-सा क्रम बताया?
o: Economic Rights → Cultural Rights → Legal Rights
Social Rights → Civil Rights → Political Rights
Political Rights → Social Rights → Civil Rights
Civil Rights (18th c.) → Political Rights (19th c.) → Social Rights (20th c.)
e:
T.H. Marshall identified three stages of citizenship rights: Civil Rights (liberty, speech, property — 18th c.), Political Rights (voting, contesting — 19th c.), and Social Rights (welfare, education, health — 20th c.).
टी.एच. मार्शल ने नागरिक अधिकार → राजनीतिक अधिकार → सामाजिक अधिकार का क्रम प्रस्तुत किया।
qe: In his classic essay 'Citizenship and Social Class' (1950), British sociologist T.H. Marshall traced the historical evolution of Citizenship Rights in which sequential order?
oe: Economic Rights → Cultural Rights → Legal Rights
Social Rights → Civil Rights → Political Rights
Political Rights → Social Rights → Civil Rights
Civil Rights (18th c.) → Political Rights (19th c.) → Social Rights (20th c.)

q: 'द आइडिया ऑफ जस्टिस' (2009) में नोबेल विजेता अमर्त्य सेन ने रॉल्स के संस्थागत न्याय की आलोचना करते हुए किन दो प्राचीन भारतीय न्याय-अवधारणाओं का अंतर प्रस्तुत किया?
o: Niti (strict organizational/rule propriety) and Nyaya (realized, actualized justice in people's lives)
e:
Amartya Sen contrasts 'Niti' (abstract institutional rules/arrangements) with 'Nyaya' (comprehensive realized justice in lived human capabilities — e.g., preventing matsya-nyaya), favouring comparative removal of manifest injustices.
अमर्त्य सेन ने 'नीति' (संस्थागत नियम) और 'न्याय' (व्यावहारिक वास्तविक न्याय) के बीच भेद किया।
qe: In 'The Idea of Justice' (2009), Nobel laureate Amartya Sen critiques Rawls's transcendental institutionalism by contrasting which two classical Indian jurisprudential concepts?
oe: Niti (strict organizational/rule propriety) and Nyaya (realized, actualized justice in people's lives)

q: अरस्तू ने अपनी कृति 'निकोमेकियन एथिक्स' में विशेष न्याय (Particular Justice) को किन दो प्रमुख रूपों में विभाजित किया?
o: Distributive Justice (proportional to merit) and Corrective/Rectificatory Justice (arithmetic equality in transactions)
e:
Aristotle distinguished Distributive Justice (allocating honours/wealth proportionally according to geometric merit) from Corrective/Remedial Justice (restoring arithmetic balance in contracts and torts).
अरस्तू ने वितरणात्मक न्याय (Distributive) तथा संशोधनात्मक न्याय (Corrective) का भेद किया।
qe: Aristotle divided Particular Justice in his 'Nicomachean Ethics' into which two major forms?
oe: Distributive Justice (proportional to merit) and Corrective/Rectificatory Justice (arithmetic equality in transactions)

q: अधिकारों का कौन-सा सिद्धांत मानता है कि कुछ मूलभूत अधिकार (जैसे जीवन, स्वतंत्रता और संपत्ति) मानव प्रकृति में निहित हैं और राज्य के निर्माण से पूर्व ही विद्यमान होते हैं?
e:
The Theory of Natural Rights (championed by John Locke and enshrined in the 1776 US Declaration & 1789 French Declaration) holds that rights are pre-political and inalienable. Jeremy Bentham dismissed natural rights as "nonsense upon stilts."
प्राकृतिक अधिकारों का सिद्धांत (जॉन लॉक) अधिकारों को राज्य से पूर्व और नैसर्गिक मानता है।
qe: Which theory of Rights asserts that certain fundamental rights (such as Life, Liberty, and Property) are inherent in human nature and exist PRIOR to the creation of the State?

q: 'स्फियर्स ऑफ जस्टिस' (1983) में 'जटिल समानता (Complex Equality)' की अवधारणा किसने प्रस्तुत की, जिसके अनुसार एक क्षेत्र (जैसे धन) में वर्चस्व अन्य क्षेत्रों (जैसे स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा या राजनीति) में वर्चस्व में नहीं बदलना चाहिए?
e:
Communitarian thinker Michael Walzer ('Spheres of Justice', 1983) proposed Complex Equality (blocking tyranny across different distributive spheres). Ronald Dworkin advocated 'Equality of Resources'.
माइकल वाल्ज़र (1983) ने 'जटिल समानता (Complex Equality)' की अवधारणा दी।
qe: Who formulated the concept of 'Complex Equality' in 'Spheres of Justice' (1983), arguing that dominance in one social sphere (like money) should NOT translate into dominance in other spheres (like health, education, or political office)?

q: "अधिकतम व्यक्तियों का अधिकतम सुख" के सिद्धांत पर आधारित प्रतिष्ठित उपयोगितावाद (Utilitarianism) की स्थापना तथा मात्रात्मक 'सुख-मापन कलन' किसने प्रस्तुत किया?
e:
Jeremy Bentham ('An Introduction to the Principles of Morals and Legislation', 1789) propounded Utilitarianism ("Nature has placed mankind under the governance of two sovereign masters, pain and pleasure").
जेरेमी बेंथम ने 'अधिकतम व्यक्तियों के अधिकतम सुख' पर आधारित उपयोगितावाद की स्थापना की।
qe: Who founded Classical Utilitarianism based on the principle of "the greatest happiness of the greatest number" and introduced the quantitative 'Felicific Calculus'?

q: प्रथम लहर के उदारवादी नारीवाद (First-Wave Liberal Feminism) का आधारभूत ग्रंथ 'ए विंडिकेशन ऑफ द राइट्स ऑफ वुमन' (1792) किसने लिखा था?
e:
Mary Wollstonecraft (1792) demanded equal education and rational citizenship for women. Simone de Beauvoir wrote 'The Second Sex' (1949, "One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman"); Betty Friedan wrote 'The Feminine Mystique' (1963); Kate Millett wrote 'Sexual Politics' (1970).
मेरी वोलस्टोनक्राफ्ट (1792) ने 'ए विंडिकेशन ऑफ द राइट्स ऑफ वुमन' लिखी।
qe: Who authored 'A Vindication of the Rights of Woman' (1792), widely regarded as the foundational text of First-Wave Liberal Feminism?

q: कार्ल मार्क्स के 'द्वंद्वात्मक भौतिकवाद' (जिसकी द्वंद्वात्मक पद्धति हेगेल से ली गई) में भौतिक एवं ऐतिहासिक विकास के तीन चरण क्या हैं?
e:
Dialectical Materialism progresses through conflict of opposites: Thesis (वाद) → Antithesis (प्रतिवाद) → Synthesis (संवाद), governed by Engels's three laws (Transformation of Quantity into Quality, Unity & Struggle of Opposites, Negation of the Negation).
द्वंद्वात्मक विकास के तीन चरण वाद, प्रतिवाद और संवाद हैं।
qe: In Karl Marx's 'Dialectical Materialism' (borrowed in method from Hegel's dialectics), what is the triad of historical/material development?

q: 'बहुसंस्कृतिवाद (Multiculturalism)' के प्रमुख समकालीन सिद्धांतकार कौन हैं, जिन्होंने 'मल्टीकल्चरल सिटिज़नशिप' (1995) लिखी और समूह-विभेदित अल्पसंख्यक अधिकारों का समर्थन किया?
e:
Canadian philosopher Will Kymlicka ('Multicultural Citizenship', 1995; along with Bhikhu Parekh & Charles Taylor) reconciled Liberalism with group-differentiated minority rights.
विल किमलिका (1995) बहुसंस्कृतिवाद के प्रमुख सिद्धांतकार हैं।
qe: Who is a leading contemporary theorist of 'Multiculturalism' (बहुसंस्कृतिवाद), known for authoring 'Multicultural Citizenship' (1995) and advocating group-differentiated minority rights (self-government, polyethnic, and special representation rights)?

q: राजनीतिक सिद्धांतकारों द्वारा महात्मा गांधी को प्रायः 'दार्शनिक अराजकतावादी (Philosophical Anarchist)' क्यों कहा जाता है?
o: Because he supported violent overthrow of parliaments
Because he advocated dictatorship of the proletariat
Because he opposed all moral duties and self-discipline
Because he viewed the State as an instrument of concentrated violence ("a soulless machine") and envisioned an ideal stateless society of self-governing Ram Rajya / village republics
e:
Unlike violent anarchists, Gandhi envisioned an 'Enlightened Anarchy' where morally self-disciplined citizens govern themselves through non-violent Gram Swaraj without needing coercive state machinery.
गांधीजी ने राज्य को हिंसा का यंत्र मानते हुए नैतिक स्वशासन पर आधारित राज्यविहीन 'रामराज्य' (प्रबुद्ध अराजकता) की कल्पना की।
qe: Why is Mahatma Gandhi often described by political theorists as a 'Philosophical Anarchist' (दार्शनिक अराजकतावादी)?
oe: Because he supported violent overthrow of parliaments
Because he advocated dictatorship of the proletariat
Because he opposed all moral duties and self-discipline
Because he viewed the State as an instrument of concentrated violence ("a soulless machine") and envisioned an ideal stateless society of self-governing Ram Rajya / village republics

q: प्लेटो ने 'द रिपब्लिक' में भ्रष्टाचार और भाई-भतीजावाद को रोकने के लिए अपना 'संपत्ति और परिवार का साम्यवाद' किन वर्गों पर लागू किया?
o: The Guardian classes (Rulers/Philosopher Kings and Auxiliaries/Soldiers) ONLY
e:
Plato's Communism applied strictly to the two Guardian classes (Rulers and Soldiers) — denying them private property and private families so they remain wholly devoted to the State. Producers retained private property and families.
प्लेटो का साम्यवाद केवल 'अभिभावक वर्ग' (शासक और सैनिक) पर लागू था, उत्पादक वर्ग पर नहीं।
qe: In Plato's 'The Republic', to which classes did Plato apply his radical 'Communism of Property and Wives (Family)' to prevent corruption and nepotism?
oe: The Guardian classes (Rulers/Philosopher Kings and Auxiliaries/Soldiers) ONLY

q: अरस्तू के संविधानों के छह-स्तरीय वर्गीकरण में "अल्प व्यक्तियों के शासन" के क्रमशः 'सामान्य (शुद्ध)' और 'विकृत' रूप क्या हैं?
e:
Aristotle's 6-fold classification: Rule by One = Monarchy (Normal) / Tyranny (Perverted); Rule by Few = Aristocracy (Normal) / Oligarchy (Perverted); Rule by Many = Polity (Normal) / Democracy (Perverted).
अल्प व्यक्तियों का शुद्ध शासन 'कुलीनतंत्र (Aristocracy)' और विकृत रूप 'धनिकतंत्र (Oligarchy)' है।
qe: In Aristotle's six-fold classification of Constitutions (by number of rulers and normal vs perverted aim), what are the NORMAL and PERVERTED forms of "Rule by the Few" respectively?

q: किस विचारक ने 'प्राकृतिक अवस्था' (सामाजिक समझौते से पूर्व) में मानव जीवन को "एकाकी, निर्धन, कुत्सित, पाशविक और अल्पायु" (प्रत्येक का प्रत्येक के विरुद्ध युद्ध) बताया?
e:
Thomas Hobbes ('Leviathan', 1651) depicted the State of Nature as chaotic war of all against all, justifying an absolute, indivisible Sovereign (Leviathan) to guarantee self-preservation and peace.
थॉमस हॉब्स ('लेवियाथन', 1651) ने प्राकृतिक अवस्था का यह चित्रण किया।
qe: Which thinker described human life in the 'State of Nature' (prior to the Social Contract) as "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish, and short" — a war of every man against every man?

q: जीन-जैक रूसो के 'द सोशल कॉन्ट्रैक्ट' (1762) में 'सामान्य इच्छा (General Will)' किस प्रकार 'सबकी इच्छा (Will of All)' से भिन्न है?
o: General Will aims at the common public good (sum of real wills), whereas Will of All is merely a sum of private selfish interests.
General Will is decided only by a hereditary monarch.
Will of All is always morally superior to General Will.
Both terms have identical meanings in Rousseau's philosophy.
e:
Rousseau distinguished Real Will (rational, aimed at common good) from Actual Will (selfish). General Will is the collective Real Will seeking public interest, whereas Will of All aggregates particular private wills.
सामान्य इच्छा सार्वजनिक कल्याण (यथार्थ इच्छाओं का योग) पर केंद्रित है, जबकि सबकी इच्छा निजी स्वार्थों का योग है।
qe: In Jean-Jacques Rousseau's 'The Social Contract' (1762), how does the 'General Will' (सामान्य इच्छा) differ from the 'Will of All' (सबकी इच्छा)?
oe: General Will aims at the common public good (sum of real wills), whereas Will of All is merely a sum of private selfish interests.
General Will is decided only by a hereditary monarch.
Will of All is always morally superior to General Will.
Both terms have identical meanings in Rousseau's philosophy.

q: कार्ल मार्क्स की '1844 की आर्थिक और दार्शनिक पांडुलिपियों' में पूँजीवाद के अंतर्गत श्रमिक को 'अलगाव (Alienation)' के किन चार आयामों का सामना करना पड़ता है?
o: Alienation from the product of labour, from the act of production, from species-being (human nature), and from fellow workers
Alienation from religion, language, army, and judiciary
Alienation from family, village, climate, and education
Alienation from Parliament, press, trade unions, and banks
e:
Young Marx identified 4 types of Alienation under capitalism: from (1) the Product, (2) the Labour Process, (3) Species-Being (Gattungswesen / creative human essence), and (4) Other Human Beings. (In 'Das Kapital', 1867, Marx developed the Theory of Surplus Value.)
मार्क्स ने उत्पाद, उत्पादन प्रक्रिया, मानव-सार (species-being) और सहकर्मियों से अलगाव के चार रूप बताए।
qe: In Karl Marx's 'Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844', which four dimensions of 'Alienation' (परायापन / अलगाव) does a worker suffer under capitalism?
oe: Alienation from the product of labour, from the act of production, from species-being (human nature), and from fellow workers
Alienation from religion, language, army, and judiciary
Alienation from family, village, climate, and education
Alienation from Parliament, press, trade unions, and banks

q: किस इतालवी मार्क्सवादी विचारक ने अपनी 'प्रिज़न नोटबुक्स' में 'सांस्कृतिक वर्चस्व (Cultural Hegemony)' की अवधारणा दी, जिसमें बताया गया कि शासक वर्ग केवल बल से नहीं बल्कि नागरिक समाज (स्कूल, मीडिया) की सहमति से प्रभुत्व बनाए रखता है?
e:
Antonio Gramsci ('Prison Notebooks') emphasized Civil Society + Political Society = Integral State, Cultural Hegemony, Organic vs Traditional Intellectuals, and War of Position vs War of Manoeuvre.
एंटोनियो ग्राम्शी ने 'सांस्कृतिक वर्चस्व (Cultural Hegemony)' का सिद्धांत प्रतिपादित किया।
qe: Which Italian Marxist thinker developed the concept of 'Cultural Hegemony' (सांस्कृतिक प्राधान्य / वर्चस्व) in his 'Prison Notebooks', explaining how the ruling class maintains dominance through civil society (schools, media, church) via consent rather than force alone?

q: प्राचीन भारतीय राजनीतिक चिंतन में मनु से संबंधित किस ग्रंथ में 'राजधर्म', 'दण्डनीति' तथा राजा की दैवीय उत्पत्ति (आठ देवताओं के अंश से निर्मित) का वर्णन मिलता है?
e:
Manusmriti (Chapter 7 — Rajadharma) describes the king as formed from eternal particles of Indra, Vayu, Yama, Surya, Agni, Varuna, Chandra, and Kubera, bound by Dharma and Danda.
मनुस्मृति के सातवें अध्याय में राजधर्म, दण्डनीति और दैवीय उत्पत्ति का उल्लेख है।
qe: In ancient Indian political thought, which text attributed to Manu outlines 'Rajadharma', 'Dandaniti', and the Divine Origin of Kingship (king created from eternal particles of eight deities)?

q: 'आध्यात्मिक राष्ट्रवाद' और 'व्यावहारिक वेदांत' का प्रतिपादन करने वाले, 1893 में शिकागो विश्व धर्म संसद में भारत का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले और "उठो, जागो और तब तक मत रुको जब तक लक्ष्य न प्राप्त हो जाए" का उद्घोष करने वाले विचारक कौन थे?
e:
Swami Vivekananda (Narendranath Datta, 1863–1902; birthday 12 January = National Youth Day) founded Ramakrishna Mission (1897) and synthesized Vedantic humanism with social service ('Daridra Narayana').
स्वामी विवेकानंद ने आध्यात्मिक राष्ट्रवाद और व्यावहारिक वेदांत का प्रतिपादन किया।
qe: Who articulated 'Spiritual Nationalism' and 'Practical Vedanta', represented India at the World's Parliament of Religions in Chicago (1893), and urged youth: "Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached"?

q: मांडले जेल में 'गीता रहस्य' लिखकर भगवद्गीता की कर्मयोग के रूप में व्याख्या करने वाले तथा स्वराज, स्वदेशी, बहिष्कार और राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा के चतुःसूत्री कार्यक्रम के प्रबल समर्थक कौन थे?
e:
Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak (edited 'Kesari' in Marathi and 'Mahratta' in English; authored 'The Arctic Home in the Vedas' and 'Gita Rahasya') was the foremost leader of assertive nationalism.
लोकमान्य बाल गंगाधर तिलक ने मांडले जेल में 'गीता रहस्य' की रचना की।
qe: Who authored 'Gita Rahasya' (written in Mandalay Jail) interpreting the Bhagavad Gita as a philosophy of Karma Yoga (activism) and championed the four-fold programme of Swaraj, Swadeshi, Boycott, and National Education?

q: रूढ़िवादी मार्क्सवाद से आगे बढ़कर विवेक और व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता पर आधारित दलविहीन जमीनी लोकतंत्र के समर्थन में 'नव-मानववाद (Radical Humanism)' का दर्शन किसने प्रतिपादित किया?
e:
M.N. Roy (founder of the Mexican Communist Party and CPI at Tashkent 1920; later founded Radical Democratic Party 1940) formulated Radical / New Humanism ('Reason, Romanticism and Revolution').
एम.एन. रॉय ने नव-मानववाद (Radical Humanism) का दर्शन दिया।
qe: Who propounded the philosophy of 'Radical Humanism' (नव-मानववाद / New Humanism) after moving beyond orthodox Marxism, advocating organized party-less grassroots democracy based on reason and individual freedom?

q: अहमदनगर किले की जेल में 'द डिस्कवरी ऑफ इंडिया' (भारत एक खोज, 1946) लिखने वाले तथा 'लोकतांत्रिक समाजवाद', 'वैज्ञानिक दृष्टिकोण' और 'गुटनिरपेक्षता' के प्रमुख प्रवर्तक कौन थे?
e:
Jawaharlal Nehru authored 'The Discovery of India', 'Glimpses of World History', and 'An Autobiography', shaping independent India's secular democratic socialism and foreign policy.
जवाहरलाल नेहरू ने 'भारत एक खोज' लिखी और लोकतांत्रिक समाजवाद व वैज्ञानिक दृष्टिकोण को बढ़ावा दिया।
qe: Which Indian leader authored 'The Discovery of India' (1946, written in Ahmednagar Fort prison) and championed 'Democratic Socialism', 'Scientific Temper', and 'Non-Alignment'?

q:
सूची-I (भारतीय संविधान की गृहीत विशेषता) को सूची-II (स्रोत देश) से सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I:
1. संसदीय प्रणाली एवं विधि का शासन
2. मौलिक अधिकार एवं स्वतंत्र न्यायपालिका
3. राज्य के नीति निदेशक तत्व (DPSP)
4. सशक्त केंद्र वाला संघ एवं अवशिष्ट शक्तियाँ
सूची-II:
(a) कनाडा
(b) आयरलैंड
(c) संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका (USA)
(d) यूनाइटेड किंगडम (UK)
e:
UK = Parliamentary Govt, Rule of Law, Single Citizenship; USA = FR, Judicial Review, Impeachment; Ireland = DPSP, RS nominations; Canada = Quasi-federal strong Centre, Residuary powers, Governor appointment.
सही सुमेलन 1-(d), 2-(c), 3-(b), 4-(a) है।
qe:
Match List-I (Borrowed Feature of Indian Constitution) with List-II (Source Country):
List-I:
1. Parliamentary System & Rule of Law
2. Fundamental Rights & Independent Judiciary
3. Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)
4. Federation with a Strong Centre & Residuary Powers
List-II:
(a) Canada
(b) Ireland
(c) United States (USA)
(d) United Kingdom (UK)

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 19(1) के अंतर्गत (संपत्ति के अधिकार के हटने के बाद) वर्तमान में केवल भारतीय नागरिकों को कितनी मूलभूत स्वतंत्रताएँ प्राप्त हैं?
e:
Article 19(1) guarantees 6 freedoms exclusively to citizens: (a) Speech & Expression, (b) Peaceful Assembly, (c) Associations/Unions/Cooperatives, (d) Free Movement, (e) Residence, and (g) Profession/Trade. Sub-clause (f) (Property) was deleted by 44th Amendment (1978).
अनुच्छेद 19(1) में वर्तमान में 6 स्वतंत्रताएँ (केवल नागरिकों को) प्राप्त हैं।
qe: Under Article 19(1) of the Indian Constitution, how many fundamental freedoms are currently guaranteed EXCLUSIVELY to Citizens of India (after the deletion of Right to Property)?

q: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा भाग और अनुच्छेद नागरिकता (एकल नागरिकता) से संबंधित हैं, तथा कौन-सा संसदीय अधिनियम भारतीय नागरिकता की प्राप्ति और समाप्ति को विनियमित करता है?
o: Part III (Articles 12–18); Representation of People Act, 1951
e:
Part II (Articles 5–11) covers Citizenship at commencement of Constitution; Article 11 empowers Parliament to regulate citizenship (Citizenship Act, 1955 — 5 modes of acquisition: Birth, Descent, Registration, Naturalisation, Incorporation of territory).
भाग II (अनुच्छेद 5–11) तथा नागरिकता अधिनियम, 1955 नागरिकता से संबंधित हैं।
qe: Which Part and Articles of the Indian Constitution govern Citizenship (Single Citizenship), and which Parliament Act regulates acquisition and termination of Indian citizenship?
oe: Part III (Articles 12–18); Representation of People Act, 1951

q: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत राष्ट्रपति को केंद्र और राज्यों के बीच समन्वय बढ़ाने हेतु 'अंतर्राज्यीय परिषद' (Inter-State Council) स्थापित करने की शक्ति प्राप्त है?
e:
Article 263 provides for the Inter-State Council (first formally constituted in 1990 on the recommendation of the Sarkaria Commission, chaired by the Prime Minister). Article 262 deals with Inter-State River Water Disputes.
अनुच्छेद 263 अंतर्राज्यीय परिषद से संबंधित है।
qe: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the President empowered to establish an 'Inter-State Council' to promote coordination between the Centre and States?

q: भारतीय संविधान के भाग III के अंतर्गत निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से मौलिक अधिकार केवल भारतीय नागरिकों को प्राप्त हैं, विदेशियों को नहीं?
e:
Exactly FIVE Articles of Fundamental Rights are reserved EXCLUSIVELY for Indian Citizens: Articles 15, 16, 19, 29, and 30. All other Fundamental Rights (14, 20, 21, 21A, 22–28) apply to both citizens and foreigners (except enemy aliens).
केवल अनुच्छेद 15, 16, 19, 29 और 30 ही अनन्य रूप से भारतीय नागरिकों को प्राप्त हैं।
qe: Which pair of Fundamental Rights under Part III of the Indian Constitution is available ONLY to Indian Citizens and NOT to foreigners (aliens)?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 66 के अंतर्गत भारत के उपराष्ट्रपति के निर्वाचन हेतु निर्वाचक मंडल में कौन शामिल होते हैं?
o: ALL members (both elected and nominated) of Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha ONLY (no State MLAs)
Only elected members of Rajya Sabha
Elected members of Lok Sabha and State Legislative Councils
e:
Under Article 66, the Vice-President is elected by ALL members (elected + nominated) of BOTH Houses of Parliament. State Legislative Assemblies do NOT participate.
उपराष्ट्रपति चुनाव में संसद के दोनों सदनों के सभी (निर्वाचित व मनोनीत) सदस्य भाग लेते हैं, राज्यों के विधायक नहीं।
qe: Under Article 66 of the Indian Constitution, who constitutes the Electoral College for the election of the Vice-President of India?
oe: ALL members (both elected and nominated) of Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha ONLY (no State MLAs)
Only elected members of Rajya Sabha
Elected members of Lok Sabha and State Legislative Councils

q: 'भारत के महान्यायवादी' (Attorney General of India — अनुच्छेद 76) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: He is appointed by the President and must be qualified to be a Judge of the Supreme Court.
He has the right of audience in all courts within the territory of India.
Under Article 88, he has the right to speak and participate in proceedings of Parliament and its committees without the right to vote.
He has a fixed constitutional tenure of 6 years and is barred from private legal practice.
e:
Statement D is NOT correct: the Attorney General holds office during the pleasure of the President (no fixed tenure) and is NOT a full-time government servant, so he is NOT debarred from private legal practice (except against the Government of India).
विकल्प D असत्य है क्योंकि महान्यायवादी का कार्यकाल निश्चित नहीं होता और उन्हें निजी वकालत से नहीं रोका गया है।
qe: Which of the following statements regarding the 'Attorney General of India' (Article 76) is NOT correct?
oe: He is appointed by the President and must be qualified to be a Judge of the Supreme Court.
He has the right of audience in all courts within the territory of India.
Under Article 88, he has the right to speak and participate in proceedings of Parliament and its committees without the right to vote.
He has a fixed constitutional tenure of 6 years and is barred from private legal practice.

q: लोकसभा में अनुदान की माँगों पर मतदान के दौरान 'सांकेतिक कटौती प्रस्ताव' (Token Cut Motion) क्या प्रस्तावित करता है?
o: Reducing the demand to ₹1 to express total disapproval of government policy
Reducing the demand by a specific large amount for economy
Reducing the amount of the demand by ₹100 to ventilate a specific grievance within the sphere of government responsibility
Doubling the grant for a specific ministry
e:
Three Cut Motions: (1) Policy Cut = reduce demand to ₹1 (policy disapproval); (2) Economy Cut = reduce by a specified amount for economy; (3) Token Cut = reduce by ₹100 to highlight a specific grievance.
सांकेतिक कटौती प्रस्ताव में किसी विशिष्ट शिकायत को उठाने हेतु माँग में ₹100 की कमी का प्रस्ताव होता है।
qe: During the voting on Demands for Grants in the Lok Sabha, what does a 'Token Cut Motion' (सांकेतिक कटौती प्रस्ताव) propose?
oe: Reducing the demand to ₹1 to express total disapproval of government policy
Reducing the demand by a specific large amount for economy
Reducing the amount of the demand by ₹100 to ventilate a specific grievance within the sphere of government responsibility
Doubling the grant for a specific ministry

q: 42वें संशोधन (1976) द्वारा जोड़े गए नीति निदेशक तत्व के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत निःशुल्क विधिक सहायता और सांविधिक 'लोक अदालतों' (विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण अधिनियम, 1987) को संचालित किया गया?
e:
Article 39A mandates Equal Justice and Free Legal Aid, operationalized via NALSA and Lok Adalats (whose award is deemed a civil court decree, final and non-appealable).
अनुच्छेद 39A समान न्याय व निःशुल्क विधिक सहायता (NALSA व लोक अदालत) से संबंधित है।
qe: Under which Article of Directive Principles (inserted by 42nd Amendment, 1976) were Free Legal Aid and statutory 'Lok Adalats' (Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987) operationalized?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 170 के अंतर्गत किसी राज्य की विधानसभा (Vidhan Sabha) की निर्वाचित सदस्य संख्या की सामान्य अधिकतम और न्यूनतम सीमा कितनी है?
e:
Article 170 fixes Vidhan Sabha strength between 60 and 500 members (with special constitutional exceptions for smaller states: Goa 40, Mizoram 40, Sikkim 32, Puducherry 30).
विधानसभा की सामान्य सीमा अधिकतम 500 और न्यूनतम 60 सदस्य है।
qe: Under Article 170 of the Indian Constitution, what are the general MAXIMUM and MINIMUM limits on the elected strength of a State Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha)?

q: क्रमशः 1983 और 2007 में गठित किन दो प्रमुख आयोगों ने केंद्र-राज्य संबंधों की व्यापक समीक्षा की और राज्यपालों की नियुक्ति व पदमुक्ति हेतु दिशानिर्देश सुझाए?
o: Sarkaria Commission (1983) and M.M. Punchhi Commission (2007)
e:
Justice R.S. Sarkaria Commission (1983–88) and Justice Madan Mohan Punchhi Commission (2007–10) are India's two landmark Centre-State Relations commissions.
सरकारिया आयोग (1983) और पुंछी आयोग (2007) केंद्र-राज्य संबंधों से जुड़े प्रमुख आयोग हैं।
qe: Which two landmark Commissions (constituted in 1983 and 2007 respectively) comprehensively examined Centre–State Relations and recommended guidelines for the appointment and removal of Governors?
oe: Sarkaria Commission (1983) and M.M. Punchhi Commission (2007)

q: 74वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1992 (अनुच्छेद 243-S) के अंतर्गत कितनी जनसंख्या वाली नगरपालिकाओं में 'वार्ड समितियों' (Wards Committees) का गठन अनिवार्य है?
e:
Article 243-S mandates constituting Wards Committees (consisting of one or more wards) within the territorial area of any Municipality having a population of 3 lakh or more.
अनुच्छेद 243-S के तहत 3 लाख या अधिक जनसंख्या वाली नगरपालिकाओं में वार्ड समितियाँ अनिवार्य हैं।
qe: Under the 74th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 (Article 243-S), the constitution of 'Wards Committees' is mandatory in municipalities having a population of:

q: पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही सुनिश्चित करने हेतु नागरिकों को लोक प्राधिकारियों से समयबद्ध सूचना माँगने का अधिकार देने वाला 'सूचना का अधिकार (RTI) अधिनियम' भारत में कब लागू हुआ?
e:
Passed in June 2005, the RTI Act came fully into force on 12 October 2005 (normal reply within 30 days; 48 hours if life or liberty is involved; Central Information Commission is the apex appellate body).
सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम 12 अक्टूबर 2005 को पूर्णतः लागू हुआ।
qe: The Right to Information (RTI) Act, empowering citizens to seek timely information from public authorities to ensure transparency and accountability, came into force across India on:

q: भारत में चुनाव सुधारों (EVM, बूथ-कैप्चरिंग रोकथाम, चुनाव का राज्य वित्तपोषण) से कौन-सी दो प्रमुख समितियाँ प्रसिद्ध रूप से जुड़ी हैं?
o: Tarkunde Committee (1974) and Dinesh Goswami Committee (1990)
Sachar Committee and Ranganath Misra Commission
Kelkar Committee and Urjit Patel Committee
e:
Major Electoral Reforms Committees: Tarkunde Committee (1974), Dinesh Goswami Committee (1990), Indrajit Gupta Committee (1998 — state funding), and Vohra Committee (1993 — criminalization of politics). (NOTA was introduced in 2013 after PUCL v. Union of India.)
तारकुंडे समिति (1974) और दिनेश गोस्वामी समिति (1990) चुनाव सुधारों से जुड़ी हैं।
qe: Which two prominent committees are famously associated with Electoral Reforms in India (recommending state funding of elections, EVMs, and anti-booth-capturing measures)?
oe: Tarkunde Committee (1974) and Dinesh Goswami Committee (1990)
Sachar Committee and Ranganath Misra Commission
Kelkar Committee and Urjit Patel Committee

q: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय न्यायालय (ICJ — संयुक्त राष्ट्र का प्रमुख न्यायिक अंग, 15 न्यायाधीश, 9-वर्षीय कार्यकाल) का स्थायी मुख्यालय तथा सार्क (SAARC) का सचिवालय क्रमशः कहाँ स्थित हैं?
e:
ICJ is headquartered at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands (the only principal UN organ located outside New York). SAARC (founded 8 Dec 1985 in Dhaka; 8 members including Afghanistan since 2007) has its Secretariat in Kathmandu, Nepal.
ICJ का मुख्यालय द हेग (नीदरलैंड्स) तथा SAARC का सचिवालय काठमांडू (नेपाल) में स्थित है।
qe: Where is the permanent headquarters of the International Court of Justice (ICJ — the principal judicial organ of the UN, with 15 judges elected for 9-year terms), and where is the Secretariat of SAARC located?
